earnings.title: Meta Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Diluted EPS of $3.83 would have increased by $3.57 to $7.40.
Revenue – Revenue was $64.60 billion, an increase of 26% year-over-year on both a reported and constant currency basis.

quotes.text: We hit major milestones this quarter toward delivering personal superintelligence for everyone - including launching Muse and Muse Wonder, our first frontier model.
quotes.by: Mark Zuckerberg, Meta founder and CEO

outlook: We expect fourth quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $73-76 billion.
Our guidance assumes foreign currency is an approximately 1% headwind to year-over-year total revenue growth, based on current exchange rates.
We are raising our expense outlook to incorporate the $9.9 billion charge related to legal proceedings recognized in the third quarter.
We now expect full year 2026 total expenses to be in the range of $175-179 billion.
